stage1.impression: A night street view through a dark steel shopfront into a long, low, timber-lined bar. The mood is right (warm, brown and black, a record wall, a candle on a small table), but the frame is underexposed and has no hero: the pair at the far end are two small dark shapes, the etched name reads as flat pale vinyl stuck on the glass, and a hard cream block at bottom right is the brightest large area in the picture. As it stands a magazine would read it as a generic dark bar seen through a window, not as a specific place built around its speakers.

blocking_9: The altar pair must be the read at a glance: speaker regions at lum_median >= 45 with their smoked tint and the light through the acrylic visible, and large enough in frame to show their silhouette (each at least ~8% of frame height)
The etched name must read as acid-etched glass (a frosted, slightly glowing tooth lit by the street) and not as opaque pale vinyl blocking the record wall
The frosted lightbox with the fogged silhouette of a dancing woman must be legible as such; it currently reads as a window into a beige room with a curtain
No hard bright non-light surface outranking the room: the cream block at bottom right must drop below the bar's pools of light
The glass must behave like a shopfront at night: faint reflections of the street lamps and kerb, so the viewer knows there is glass
The central steel mullion must not bisect the room's vanishing point and the counter; the room's depth axis wants a clear pane
Full-resolution check of grain and denoiser smear on the concrete and steel (this proof is 0.3 scale and too soft to judge 1:1 texture)

defects.what: Left altar speaker almost illegible: lum_median 19.1, no tint or acrylic glow visible, reads as a black box
Right altar speaker almost illegible: lum_median 20.3
Etched name reads as opaque pale pink vinyl (lum_median 51, flat fill) covering the record wall and cropped hard at the left edge ('ARF')
Lightbox does not read as a frosted panel with a fogged dancing figure: reads as a view into a beige room with a curtain and a lit window; glow very uneven (p5 10, p95 146)
Hard-edged cream block (sill or pavement) at lum_median 123.5, the brightest large non-lamp area in frame, pulls the eye out of the room
Bare ceiling source at the back clips (33% of its pixels at 255) and reads as a bare bulb pointed at camera
Steel mullion splits the frame and the counter down the left-centre
Bottom band (stallriser) 13.5% crushed, lum_median 7.9; dead area
No reflections on the glass: the shopfront reads as an open hole, not glass
Small cold blue screen glow on the counter is the only saturated colour, competing with the speakers' tint

changes.problem: The hero pair at the altar is too dark to read, so the frame has no subject.

evidence.measured: speaker regions lum_median 19.1 and 20.3; altar region [300,190,470,310] lum_median 20.1

change.setting: lamps: the altar 2 x spot, W; and on each speaker area lamps, W/m2
change.from: altar spots 90.0 W, speaker area lamps 1.0 W/m2
change.to: altar spots 240 W (cone 36 deg kept, 2500 K), speaker area lamps 3.0 W/m2

changes.expected: The two cabinets separate from the back wall as smoked, lit acrylic with the white batts showing through; speaker regions near 45-60.

changes.problem: The whole frame is underexposed below the night-interior band.
changes.expected: Frame median about 24-30 with the shadows holding timber and concrete detail; the ceiling source stays the only clipped area.

changes.problem: The altar pair is tiny and far off, and the mullion bisects the counter and the room's depth axis.

evidence.measured: mullion runs the full height at x~200; each speaker is ~55 px of a 480 px frame (~11%) but reads smaller because it is dark

change.to: position [-2.0, 1.6, 1.45], lens 40 mm, aim [17.0, 3.0, 1.3], so that the room's vanishing point and the altar sit in one clear pane on the right of the mullion, with the steel frame as a dark edge at left and right

changes.expected: The altar pair about 1.25x larger, framed by the far opening in a clean pane; the counter runs unbroken from the left edge to the back.

changes.problem: The etched name reads as opaque vinyl, not etched glass, and blots out the record wall.

evidence.measured: flat fill lum_median 51.2 with the letters in a uniform pale pink, more opaque than the record wall behind

change.setting: the window's etched name: emission strength and the etch's finish
change.to: emission 0.0; etch as rough clear (roughness ~0.5, transmission kept ~0.8) so it is lit only by the street lamps and the room behind, showing as a faint frosted tooth

changes.expected: Letters legible as a soft grey frost through which the shelves are still visible, region median about 30-40.

changes.problem: A hard cream block at bottom right is brighter than any surface inside the room.

change.setting: lamps: street lamps 3 x point, and the sill/pavement finish
change.to: 60 W, 3000 K, the nearest lamp moved back off the sill; pavement and sill finish darkened to a wet grey concrete (base value ~0.15)

changes.expected: The sill sits at about the level of the bar's floor pool, so the eye goes through the glass to the room.

changes.problem: The frosted lightbox does not read as frosted acrylic carrying a fogged silhouette of a dancing woman.

evidence.measured: lum_p5 10.3, lum_p95 145.8; reads as a room with a lit window and curtain behind clear glass

change.to: roughness 0.6-0.7 so the figure behind is fogged and the face glows evenly

changes.expected: An evenly glowing warm panel with a soft dark figure in it; no legible room behind.

changes.problem: The bare source at the back clips and reads as a naked bulb aimed at the lens.

change.setting: the screens' / disc / lamp nearest that position (whichever fixture it is): brightness
change.to: halve its emission (e.g. disc 0.3 -> 0.15 or the relevant spot visible face hidden)

changes.expected: A glowing but unclipped point, no hotspot drawing the eye above the altar.

changes.problem: Nothing tells the viewer there is glass, and the room is empty of air.

evidence.measured: floor pool reads cleanly with no reflection overlay; haze 0.003 gives no visible beam

change.from: haze 0.003; glass with no visible reflection
change.to: haze 0.006; keep the shopfront glass a true clear pane (IOR 1.5, roughness 0) so the street lamps and kerb show as faint reflections in the dark lower panes

changes.expected: Faint street reflections in the stallriser-level panes and soft cones under the Domes; the dead bottom band gains a little value.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speakers' smoked tint more saturated so they carry the frame's colour
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour is fixed by the configuration (Smoke); only their lighting may change

out_of_scope.request: Remove or move the central shopfront mullion
out_of_scope.why: The shopfront is part of the room's fixed design; handled by moving the camera (c3) instead

out_of_scope.request: Recut the window lettering so the full name reads in frame
out_of_scope.why: The etched name's position and size are part of the fixed shopfront; the camera change may bring it fully into frame
